You type every word yourself, on the app's Arabic keyboard or your phone's, so you learn where each letter lives. 36 lessons cover the alphabet, tashkeel, and the most common words. Every word has audio, and words you miss come back for review. No account, no ads. Lesson 1 is free.
arabictyper.target_customers_original: Arabic beginners and heritage speakers who text in Arabizi
arabictyper.pricing_original: Lesson 1 free. $7.99/month, $39.99/year with 7 free days, or $79.99 lifetime
arabictyper.value_proposition_original: Teaches you to read and type Arabic, starting with alif
arabictyper.problem_solved_original: Learners who can say Arabic words still can't find the letters on a keyboard
